name: BlackVault Commander
tagline: Connect Cline to your authorized computers using account-scoped remote tools.
description: Connect to your paired computers through BlackVault Commander. Check device status, monthly usage and approved diagnostics, and request supported Windows operations within your granted permissions. Requires a BlackVault account and a paired device for device operations. OAuth sign-in is required; device and operation permissions remain enforced by BlackVault. Local approval applies where required.

install.notes: Complete BlackVault OAuth sign-in and authorize only the permissions you need. Pair your own computer in the BlackVault control center before requesting device operations.
